subject: mathematics
question_text: Find the determinant of the matrix with rows (1², 2², 3²), (2², 3², 4²) and (3², 4², 5²).

recall_prompt: Say how you would find this determinant.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write out the squares
steps.margin_note: First mark. Replace every square with its value before doing anything else, so the rest of the work is on a plain numerical determinant.
steps.memory_tip: Replace every square with its value first, then work with the plain numerical determinant.

recall.must_convey: That every squared entry is replaced by its numerical value before expanding.
accept: work out all the squares first so the matrix becomes one four nine, four nine sixteen, nine sixteen twenty five
replace each square with its number then expand
write the numerical matrix before doing the determinant
modata squares ni numbers ga rasi tarvata expand cheyyali
turn the squares into numbers first

steps.why: Once the squares are written as numbers the question is an ordinary 3×3 determinant. Row subtractions do shorten this one, but the direct expansion is safe and earns both marks.
common_mistakes: Expanding with the squares still written as powers and losing track.
Reading 2² as 4² somewhere in the grid.

steps.label: Expand along the first row
steps.margin_note: Second mark. No zeros here, so all three terms are needed. The middle term carries a minus sign, and all three minors come out negative.
steps.memory_tip: No zeros here, so all three terms are needed, and the middle one carries a minus.

recall.must_convey: That the determinant is expanded along the first row with the plus-minus-plus signs, giving −8.
accept: expand along the first row with plus minus plus and it comes to minus eight
the three terms are minus thirty one plus one seventy six minus one fifty three which is minus eight
first row expand cheste minus eight vasthundi

steps.why: The sign pattern along the top row is plus, minus, plus. With every minor negative, dropping the middle minus flips the answer entirely.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the minus in front of the middle term.

insider_note: Square every entry before doing anything else, or the determinant is of the wrong matrix. The answer is negative, −8, which is correct and not a sign slip.
